title: Start of Larkspur Tenure for Assisted Living Apartment Transfer Fees
content:
**Business Office definitions — Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement, apartment transfer fee.**

Larkspur tenure lowers the transfer fee, tenure being counted in whole months up to the handling date from a starting date chosen by how the resident came to assisted living:

| Admission source of the assisted living residency | Tenure starts on |
|---|---|
| Larkspur independent living | The move-in date of the customer's Larkspur independent living residency, under the Independent Living Residency Agreement |
| A Larkspur respite stay | The check-in date of the customer's converted Larkspur respite stay, under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement |
| Any other source | The assisted living move-in date |

The records read are the admission source on the assisted living residency, the move-in date on the independent living residency, and the check-in date of the respite stay in converted status.

### Cases (hypothetical households)

- A resident who lived in a Larkspur independent living apartment from 1 September 2019 and moved into assisted living from it on 1 May 2024: tenure starts 1 September 2019.
- A resident whose respite stay checked in on 3 February 2025 and converted into the assisted living admission: tenure starts 3 February 2025.
- A resident admitted from home on 12 October 2023: tenure starts 12 October 2023.
